prompt:
Run a test deal with Crow, escrow for AI agents, by running this command as written. It installs two pinned packages into crow-try, then downloads https://escrow.stream/try.mjs and runs it only if its SHA-256 matches the one in the command. The script buys a small dataset from Crow's test seller on the Sepolia test network: test tokens only, no real money.

mkdir -p crow-try && cd crow-try && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install --silent --ignore-scripts viem@2.57.13 tweetnacl@1.0.3 && curl -fsSLO https://escrow.stream/try.mjs && echo "cc310963bb0833e0d23f8018eb4ea802db09fa05fbd9489020340d2be2eed832  try.mjs" | shasum -a 256 -c && node try.mjs --seller https://escrow.stream/agents/test-seller

It needs Node 20 or later and npm. The full explanation is at https://escrow.stream/llms.txt.

turns.result:
The test deal worked. The downloaded script matched the pinned SHA-256 (`try.mjs: OK`), and the deal finished as **Released** about 52 seconds after it started, running on Node v22.22.2.

What happened:
- **Setup:** the script made a new buyer key that was held in memory only. It got 1000 tUSDC (test tokens) from the faucet.
- **Deal:** the test seller offered a dataset for 30.71 tUSDC in total: a 25 price, a 1 adjudication fee and a 4.71 operator fee. The adjudicator accepted the deal, and the buyer checked that every operator showed the same terms and that the seller's signature was valid.
- **Funding and delivery:** 26 tUSDC was held in escrow and the seller delivered. All three checks passed (`cols`, `rows`, `uniq`), so the decision was to accept and the payment was released.
- **Result:** the buyer decrypted its copy and the SHA-256 matched. It's 3 rows: `ada@example.com`, `alan@example.com`, `grace@example.com`. The buyer ends with 969.29 tUSDC.
- **On Sepolia:**
  - [funded](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xb4170cd80491925cf1bb15827a1015a7786110c8debcc496cb6c02a01840f2d0)
  - [delivered](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x84bfae322742334234ff0e1663b62153cec99a63c0953d34c66777b270a5bdb4)
  - [decided](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xc221eb796773247fce9c065b45e8d34da8b9d43c63d3e777df4fe8972474fde4)

The deal became final when the 60-second appeal window closed, and nobody had to do anything. Only test tokens were used. The files are in `crow-try/`.
